name: Lar Prowltusk
summary: Southwest of Sen'jin Village, Lar Prowltusk keeps watch over Durotar's frontier. He guards the young troll settlement and sends travelers against nearby threats.

sections.title: Watcher on the Coast
sections.body:
Lar Prowltusk watches the coast southwest of Sen'jin Village. As a Darkspear sentinel, he helps guard the tribe's new home after its people fled their sunken island chain. Hostile neighbors still harass Sen'jin Village as the trolls work to secure a permanent home.

So Lar directs scouts and warriors to watch the coast and curb these attacks. He pays special attention to the Kolkar centaur, giving the settlement room to breathe.

faq.answer: Lar Prowltusk guards the outskirts of Sen'jin Village in Durotar. The Darkspear sentinel sends Horde travelers against regional threats before they reach the settlement.

faq.q: What threats does Lar Prowltusk focus on?
faq.answer: Lar Prowltusk watches Durotar's frontier for danger, especially marauding Kolkar centaur packs pushing into troll territory.

faq.q: Where can Lar Prowltusk be found?
faq.answer: Lar Prowltusk keeps watch along the paths southwest of Sen'jin Village in southern Durotar.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you depend on scouts like Lar Prowltusk to guard your tribe's fragile new home in Durotar from aggressive centaur clans and encroaching human forces.
As a member of the Horde, you share Lar Prowltusk's struggle to secure Durotar's borders against threats near your fledgling capital.
